input: Summarize the core purpose of .claude/contracts/schemas.md in one sentence.
expected_output: It defines machine-readable structured contract schemas for skill and agent output, enforcing a standard YAML block for inter-agent communication and pipeline automation.
notes: Validates understanding of the repo's structured I/O contract layer.

input: Describe the role of .claude/agents/eval-judge.md in the blueprint.
expected_output: It defines the read-only judge agent that scores skill outputs against rubric files and optionally writes baseline evaluation results.
notes: Checks understanding of the repo's eval judge agent.

input: Explain the purpose of a golden dataset in the CLAUDE blueprint.
expected_output: A golden dataset provides curated reference cases with known correct outputs so the eval harness can verify model behavior deterministically.
notes: Ensures the harness tests against concrete expected results.

input: What is the difference between an agent harness and an eval harness in this repo?
expected_output: An agent harness orchestrates agent definitions, tools, and memory, while an eval harness executes evaluation cases, scorer logic, and result aggregation.
notes: Validates understanding of runtime responsibility boundaries.
